The table is adorned with colorful decorative tiles on its lower front panel, featuring intricate patterns and vibrant colors such as red, yellow, blue, green, and pink. These tiles add a lively and artistic touch to the otherwise simple design of the table. On top of the table, there is a small, ornate teapot with a green handle and lid, along with two matching cups, one red and one blue.
